supplier will cease operations or become inactive over the next 12 months based  SUPPLIER RISK
on information in the Dun & Bradstreet Data Cloud. Using statistical probability  6
factors, it scores public and private companies from 1 to 9, where 1 represents low
risk and 9 represents high risk. The SER Rating provides powerful supplier insight  9  1
by combining key risk indicators into a single rating.

D&B Rating is an indicator typically used by financial institutions, vendors and
suppliers to help assess the creditworthiness of your business. Your D&B Rating is
D&B RATING
determined by combining your business’s net worth and the summary of your
business’s financial health, payment habits and operational performance.  --

Previous Rating

What is my Current Rating?  As of Mar 25, 2026
This represents the absence of a D&B Rating and should not be interpreted as indicating that
credit should be denied. It means that the information available to D&B does not permit us
--  to classify the company within our Rating Key and that further inquiry should be made before
reaching a credit decision. Some reasons for using the "- -" symbol include: deficit net worth,
bankruptcy proceedings, lack of sufficient payment information or incomplete history
indicator.

UCC Filings
UCC FILINGS
UCC Filings are legal documents creditors use to secure their rights to
collateral specified in a secured financing agreement.  0
These give the creditor a legally recognized interest in the collateral until
Latest Filing Date payment is received in full. It also provides legal title to these assets in
-- the event a debtor suffers financial hardship and is unable to meet its
promise to pay.
This section will list any UCC filings related to your business.
